newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's NSW 11-month budget surplus A$579 mln.
newsitem.headline: Australia's NSW 11-month budget surplus A$579 mln.

text.p: The New South Wales state government said on Thursday the underlying result for the state's budget sector was a surplus of A$579 million for the 11 months to May 31.
This compares to a surplus of A$402 million for the same period last year.
The final result for 1996/97 was still expected to be an underlying surplus of around A$67 million as forecast in the State Budget delivered on May 6, the government said.
